visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, is positioned in the center of the frame against a backdrop showing a large bird (a Malayan Night Heron) and green foliage. A large white rounded rectangular box with blue text hangs at the top. (2) While the man continues speaking and gesturing with his hands (holding a blue pen), a screenshot of an online news article titled 'Earth Is Broadcasting Its Location to Aliens – And We Didn't Mean To' appears as a semi-transparent overlay in the middle of the screen. (3) The news article overlay is replaced by an animated 3D globe heatmap showing radio signal intensity across the continents (Africa, Europe, Asia), accompanied by a line graph at the bottom indicating signal fluctuations over 24 hours. (4) The visuals shift to a cinematic depiction of Earth in dark space with a concentrated beam of brilliant blue light shooting vertically from the planet's surface into the cosmos. (5) A real-world video clip of a rotating airport radar antenna on a tall metal tower under a cloudy sky is overlaid, showing the mechanical motion of the surveillance equipment. (6) The scene returns to the initial setup with the man speaking directly to the camera against the bird background, using emphatic hand gestures and holding the blue pen while white subtitles appear at the bottom.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 外星文明有機會發現地球. [Subtitle]: 地球正在向外星人廣播. (2) [Subtitle]: 透露自己的位置, 話就說到這, 懂的人就懂. (3) [Subtitle]: 蛤 不懂啊? 英國曼徹斯特大學的博士生. [Logo]: PanSci 泛科學. (4) [Subtitle]: 拉米羅羅斯凱塞德, 最近在英國皇家天文學會的年度, 全國天文學會會議上發表了研究. (5) [Subtitle]: 他指出我們地球上用來指揮飛機起降的機場雷達, 還有軍事單位用的雷達系統. (6) [Subtitle]: 其實一直在對外太空洩漏大量的電磁波訊號. (7) [Subtitle]: 他模擬了地球發出的雷達訊號, 如何隨時間在太空中傳播. (8) [Subtitle]: 以評估這些訊號在鄰近恆星系統的可探測程度. (9) [Subtitle]: 他們還分析了全球雷達裝置的分布, 如何影響從六個特定恆星系統. (10) [Subtitle]: 包括巴納德星, HD 48948, HD 40307, 顯微鏡座 AU 星, HD 216520 和 LHS 475. (11) [Subtitle]: 觀測到的地球無線電訊號的時間結構. (12) [Subtitle]: 這洩漏有多嚴重, 科學家計算, 光是全球機場雷達加起來, 就等於是用一個 2x10 的 15 次方瓦. (13) [Subtitle]: 也就是兩拍瓦的超強燈泡, 在對宇宙發訊號. (14) [Subtitle]: 這強度足以讓遠在 200 光年外的外星文明. (15) [Subtitle]: 用跟我們差不多等級的電波望遠鏡, 清楚偵測到我們. (16) [Subtitle]: 在宇宙裡看起來, 絕對是 Artificial. (17) [Subtitle]: 但這些對地或對空的雷達, 究竟為什麼會洩漏到外太空呢? 主要有三個物理原因. (18) [Subtitle]: 第一, 天線的物理限制. 任何雷達天線在發射主訊號束的同時. (19) [Subtitle]: 都無可避免地會產生能量較弱的旁瓣. (20) [Subtitle]: 這就像手電筒的主光束旁, 總會有些餘光. (21) [Subtitle]: 這些從旁洩漏的能量雖然低, 但依然朝著不同方向進入太空. (22) [Subtitle]: 第二, 大氣層的透明性. 大氣層對雷達用的無線電波來說. (23) [Subtitle]: 是暢通無阻的無線電窗口, 訊號可以幾乎沒有阻礙地穿透出去. (24) [Subtitle]: 第三, 是發射源的超高功率. 機場與軍事雷達功率極高. (25) [Subtitle]: 所以就算是從旁瓣漏出去的微小能量. (26) [Subtitle]: 也遠比其他人造訊號還強, 能在星際間傳播很長的距離. (27) [Subtitle]: 機場雷達還算和平, 但軍事雷達的訊號傳過去. (28) [Subtitle]: 在外星人耳裡聽起來不就是宇宙級的, 你咧看啥潲. (29) [Subtitle]: 事已至此, 已經發送的訊號也收不回來了. 你是降臨派、拯救派, 還是倖存派的呢?

(2) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition as the voice introduces a scientific study. The background music remains constant. (3) The speaker's tone becomes more animated as he mentions 'Artificial' signals, with the BGM rhythm becoming slightly more pronounced but remaining under the vocals. (4) The audio environment maintains its studio-clean quality as the speaker lists specific astronomical codes and physics concepts, with a short digital 'click' sound effect accompanying a visual change. (5) The speaker concludes with a rhetorical question, his voice rising in pitch for emphasis, as the synthesizer music fades slightly while maintaining its rhythmic pulse until the end.
